## How they got there
Inter reached the 2024-25 final as a runner-up after losing to Paris Saint-Germain 0-5. Their path was built on exceptional consistency, evidenced by a points per game average of 2.38, which places them in the 94th percentile among that season's teams and the 91st percentile historically. They maintained strong defensive solidity with only 2.9 opponent shots on target per game, ranking in the 10th percentile across all Champions League history since 2011-12. The team also covered significant ground, logging 68.1 km per game, a figure that sits at the very bottom of historical distributions (0th percentile), indicating extreme physical output despite being marked as "lower is better" for some metrics in this context.

## Would the model have picked them?
If the model had evaluated Inter before this specific season began, it likely would have selected them to reach the final. The algorithm assigned a 12.9% probability of reaching the final, which significantly exceeds the base rate of 8.3% for any random knockout team. This confidence placed Inter at rank 7 among the 24 teams that reached the knockout stages. Although their expected stage was calculated at 0.87—suggesting a projection closer to the quarter-finals than the final—the statistical profile pushed them above average. The model recognized their high preseason coefficient of 101.0 points (86th percentile) and superior goal difference per game of 1.25 as key indicators of potential success, even though they ultimately fell short in the decisive match.

## Weak spots
Despite reaching the final, Inter displayed clear statistical vulnerabilities that likely hindered their performance against top opposition. Their shot accuracy was a major concern, with only 39.2% of shots on target, ranking in the 8th percentile for the season and 12th historically; this metric contributed -0.12 to their knockout stage prediction. Furthermore, they generated fewer attacks per game than many rivals, averaging 38.4 (35th percentile), which dragged their expected performance down by -0.19 stages. They also committed fouls at a rate of 9.6 per game, resulting in a negative SHAP contribution of -0.08. While they excelled in distance covered and passing volume, these inefficiencies in finishing and attacking frequency prevented them from securing the title.
